actions.label:    wi-fi
actions.command: sh -c 'if ! nmcli -t -f TYPE device | grep -qx wifi; then notify-send -a "quick settings" -i network-wireless-disabled "no wi-fi on this computer" "there is no wi-fi adapter, so it uses a wired connection."; exit 0; fi; [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'nmcli -t -f TYPE device | grep -qx wifi && [ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = enabled ] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label:    bluetooth
actions.command: sh -c 'if ! bluetoothctl list | grep -q Controller; then notify-send -a "quick settings" -i bluetooth-disabled "no bluetooth on this computer" "there is no bluetooth adapter."; exit 0; fi; [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && bluetoothctl power on || bluetoothctl power off'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.label:    airplane
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && nmcli radio all off || nmcli radio all on'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = disabled ] && [ "$(nmcli radio wwan)" != enabled ] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label:    night light
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && (pgrep -x wlsunset || setsid wlsunset -T 4500 -t 3500 >/dev/null 2>&1 &) || pkill -x wlsunset'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pgrep -x wlsunset >/dev/null && echo true || echo false'
